{{recipesummary|category=Breakfast recipes|servings=6–8|time=3 hours altogether|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast Cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
* 1 package (16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) of [[Cookbook:Sage|sage]]-flavored [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]]
* [[Cookbook:Pinch|Pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 4 cups [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]] stale [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* 4 ounces shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]

==Procedure==
# Brown sausage and sprinkle with pepper.
# Drain off excess fat, and let sausage cool.
# [[Cookbook:Beat|Beat]] eggs and add milk.
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in cubes of stale bread, cheese, and cooled sausage.
# Pour into and 8 by 8-inch [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] coated with [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|cooking spray]].
# Refrigerate for at least an hour (or freeze for later).
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|325°F]]. [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] for 1 hour.
# Cool and cut into squares.
